message: At 200.00 a month, the average of the last 3 complete months, Urlaub would reach 2000.00 in 2027-03, 6 months from now (1200.00 still to go). To reach it by 2027-03: 171.43 a month over 7 months; the current pace gets there in time.
name: Urlaub
notes: contribution is the average, over the months listed, of what was assigned to the category plus its activity (spending negative, refunds positive): what its balance actually grew by. Assigned alone would ignore what is spent out of the category and promise too early a date; both are given apart.
The projection starts from what the category holds today and adds contribution for each month after this one: what is still to be assigned this month counts as next month's.
monthly_needed spreads what is missing evenly over the months from this one to target_month, both included, as YNAB counts a target by date.
The past is no promise: a raise, a large purchase out of the category or a month assigned twice changes the pace.
